intro: More school and university vocabulary: the people, the places and the study techniques.
p.secretaría.consejo: The accent breaks the diphthong: se-kre-ta-RI-a. At the secretaría you enrol.
p.catedrático.consejo: It comes from «cátedra», the post of the senior professor. It has an accent on the «á».
p.tutor.consejo: A woman is «la tutora». It is also the legal guardian of a minor.
p.conferencia.consejo: Careful: «lectura» is reading, not a talk. A guest gives a «conferencia».
p.intercambio.consejo: You do «un intercambio» between schools or universities in different countries.
p.prácticas.consejo: It is almost always plural: «hacer prácticas» in a company.
p.matricularse.consejo: It is reflexive: «me matriculo en la universidad». What you pay is «la matrícula».
p.apuntes.consejo: It is used in the plural: «tomar apuntes». A single «apunte» is a short note.
p.subrayar.consejo: It comes from «raya» (line): «sub-rayar» is to put a line underneath.
p.esquema.consejo: It sums up a topic with key words and arrows. It is masculine: «el esquema».
p.resumen.consejo: Its verb is «resumir». The plural takes an accent: «resúmenes».
p.repasar.consejo: You «repasas» before an exam. It comes from «pasar» through the lesson again.
p.equivocarse.consejo: It is reflexive: «me equivoco». «Equivocarse de aula» is to go into the wrong classroom.
p.corregir.consejo: The e becomes i and the g becomes j: «corrijo», «corriges». The teacher marks the exams.
b1.texto:
Today we talk about school, university and how people study.

- **The system:** after the ESO there are two years of **bachillerato** and then university.
- **At university:** you **te matriculas** (enrol) at the **secretaría**. The **catedrático** is the most senior teacher and each student has a **tutor**. With an **intercambio** you study abroad and with **prácticas** you work in a company.
- **Classes:** a **conferencia** is a talk by a guest. Careful: a *lectura* is a text to read.
- **To study:** you take **apuntes**, **subrayas** the important parts, make an **esquema** and a **resumen**, and **repasas** before the exam.
- **When there are problems:** «Tengo una duda», «Me he **equivocado**». The teacher **corrige** the exams.
b2.f0.texto: Will you lend me your notes from the lecture?
b2.f2.texto: At the end there is an outline of each topic.
b2.f3.texto: Do you learn it all by heart?
b2.f4.texto: I make a summary of each topic on one sheet.
b2.f5.texto: The night before I go over it calmly.
b2.f6.texto: I have a question about the professor's exam.
b2.f7.texto: Ask at the office or talk to your tutor.
b2.f8.texto: Yesterday I went to the wrong classroom and arrived late.
b4.texto:
Verbs in **-ir** such as **corregir**, **repetir**, **pedir**, **elegir** and **seguir** change the **e** of the stem into **i** when that syllable carries the stress:

- **corregir** → corrijo, corriges, corrige, corregimos, corregís, corrigen
- **repetir** → repito, repites, repite, repetimos, repetís, repiten

In **nosotros** and **vosotros** the **e** does not change.

With **corregir** and **elegir** there is one more change in spelling: before **o** the **g** becomes **j** (**corrijo**, **elijo**) to keep the sound.

Verbs in **-ar** and **-er** do not make this change.
b4.e0.texto: The teacher marks the exams in the afternoon.
b4.e1.texto: I correct the mistakes in the summary.
b4.e2.texto: My tutor always repeats the same question.
b5.f0.texto: The university library smells of old paper and cold coffee.
b5.f1.texto: Under the green lamps, the students write in silence.
b5.f2.texto: A girl arranges the notes from the lecture on the table.
b5.f3.texto: With a yellow marker she underlines the important dates.
b5.f4.texto: Then she draws an outline with arrows and circles.
b5.f5.texto: Beside her, a boy goes over the summary by heart.
b5.f6.texto: He moves his lips without making a sound.
b5.f7.texto: Sometimes he gets a date wrong and starts again.
b5.f8.texto: An hour later, the tutor walks through the room and smiles.
b5.f9.texto: The two friends go out into the corridor and take a break with a cup of tea.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! A guest speaks to the audience.
b6.o1.refuerzo: That is a «lectura». A «conferencia» is listened to.
b6.o2.refuerzo: An exam is done on paper. A «conferencia» is a talk.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Before «o» the g becomes j to keep the sound: corrijo.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Well done! The e becomes i and the g becomes j: corrijo.
b8.frase: Hago un resumen de cada tema
b8.traduccion: I make a summary of each topic
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Repasar» is to study it again; it marks nothing on paper.
b9.o1.refuerzo: That's it! «Subrayar» is to put a line under it.
b9.o2.refuerzo: «Corregir» is to fix mistakes, not to mark the important parts.
b9.pregunta: You want to mark the key part. What do you do?
b11.o0.refuerzo: Well done! «Me he equivocado» is the past with «haber».
b11.o1.refuerzo: After «he» you need a participle, not the infinitive.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Equivocas» is the present for «tú». After «he» comes the participle.
b12.o0.refuerzo: A placement is work in a company, not study abroad.
b12.o1.refuerzo: That's it! An exchange is studying for a while in another country.
b12.o2.refuerzo: A lecture is a one-hour talk, not a long stay.
b12.pregunta: You study six months in another country. What are you doing?
p.subrayado.consejo: Past participle of «subrayar»: the y sounds like the English «y».
p.tema.consejo: «Tema» is the topic of a lesson or text; it is a masculine word.
p.folio.consejo: «Folio» is a sheet of paper, often A4 size.
p.repaso.consejo: «Repaso» is a review of what you learned; it comes from «repasar».
p.corrige.consejo: From «corregir»: the g before i sounds like h.
p.errores.consejo: «Error» is a mistake; the plural is «errores».
p.rotulador.consejo: «Rotulador» is a felt-tip pen used to highlight.
p.subraya.consejo: From «subrayar»: the y at the end sounds like the English y.
p.fechas.consejo: «Fecha» is a date; the ch sounds as in English «church».
p.equivoca.consejo: From «equivocarse»: «se equivoca» means he or she is wrong.
p.experto.consejo: «Experto» is an expert: the x sounds like «ks».
p.ejercicios.consejo: «Ejercicio» is an exercise; the j sounds like h and the c like th.
p.equivocado.consejo: «Equivocado» means wrong; it is the past participle form.
p.equivoqué.consejo: From «equivocarse»: the qu sounds like k.
